lessons.title: A01 — Greetings and introductions
lessons.content:
LESSON A01 — Greetings and introductions

LEARNING OBJECTIVE
By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to use greetings and introductions accurately in everyday and practical communication.

WARM-UP
Discuss what you already know about this topic. Give two examples in English.

LANGUAGE FOCUS
Study the key words, expressions and sentence patterns introduced by your teacher. Notice word order, meaning and pronunciation.

MODEL PRACTICE
A: Could you explain that, please?
B: Of course. Let me give you an example.
A: Thank you. I understand now.

GUIDED PRACTICE
1. Write three original sentences using the target language.
2. Ask a partner two questions related to the lesson.
3. Listen to a partner and note the key information.

INDEPENDENT TASK
Prepare a short spoken or written response (5–8 sentences) using the lesson language.

SELF-CHECK
